package.name: algae_dt
package.description: Custom digital-twin package for a TurtleBot3 Burger algae-bloom cleaner (TU/e 2IRR10). Thin DT layer (mediator / sync supervisor / mission / operator GUI) on top of the DEFAULT turtlebot3 packages (turtlebot3_gazebo, turtlebot3_navigation2, turtlebot3_bringup, turtlebot3_teleop). Those default packages are provided by the environment and launched at runtime; they are intentionally NOT declared as build/exec deps here (course "custom package on top of default packages" model, mirroring my_tb3_world / tb3_safety_stop).
